correctness.rationale: The target is the parity of positional embeddings after every binary prefix, including the empty input. Lucas gives P=2^(1+floor(log₂a)) as a period of f(z)=binom(z,a) mod 2. A smaller period would give a proper period dividing P, hence also period P/2, contradicted by f(a)=1 and f(a−P/2)=0. Updating the prefix counts uses only old coordinates. On phase zero, the action on the middle counters is M=I+N; shifting to phase a for the one-letter update and shifting back adds e₁ to M. The actions are finite permutations, so inverse powers are realizable by words. Composing and conjugating gives translations by M^t e₁, whose first b columns form the invertible triangular Pascal basis. Thus every base state occurs. For a≥2,b≥2, the stem 0^a1^(b−1)0^(P−a) gives B_(b−1)=1 and f(P+1)+f(P)=binom(P,a−1)=0; swapping the last two letters therefore holds the base fixed and flips C. For a=1,b≥2, with r the least power of two at least b, the displayed words have equal B_j because binom(r,j−1) vanishes for 1≤j−1<b≤r, and opposite C because binom(r−1,b) is odd for b<r and zero for b=r, while binom(r+1,b) does the reverse. For b=1,a even, the last-letter swap compares the odd binom(a+1,a) and binom(a,a) and changes C by one. Opposite lifts then propagate together by a common suffix to every base. In the exceptional case b=1,a odd, contributing one-positions see an odd number of preceding zeros by Lucas, so each final-zero factor is congruent to z−1, giving C=(z−1)B₁. Distinguishability is proved, not inferred from reachability: the empty suffix fixes C, the b+1 outputs after 1^t0 extract the middle coordinates and f(z) in triangular order, and the shifts 0^r1^b0 recover the rotation of f and thus z. The same triangular tests for B_b with the final 0 omitted distinguish base states when viewing the two-run counter by itself. No extrapolation is needed.

reproduction.result: A full prefix-state implementation (not the compressed phase machine) enumerated and Moore-minimized all 66 cases 1≤a≤11, 1≤b≤6 against the actual output bit, finding 26,604 reachable states total with no merges. Literal embeddings checked 65,520 word/pattern cases. Separate checks reproduced 4,914 witness pairs, 40 separating-signature cases on 7,148 states, and 877,440 invariant instances. The two frozen scripts were inspected, not run; none of these bounded checks certifies the infinite theorem, priority, or an external attestation.

evidence: The all-modulus two-run theorem gives m^b times the product of p^(e+floor(log_p a)) over p^e exactly dividing m, so at m=2 it supplies the full P·2^b base count. Its scope stops before the returning zero. The generalized Parikh-matrix theorem passages give homomorphism and matrix identities, not a calculated minimal output quotient.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Representing a count by matrices or a weighted automaton does not evaluate the index of its observable-state stabilizer. The relevant stronger coverage would need either exact state indices for these patterns or a structural theorem that implies their lift. No such implication was established by the passages actually read.

originality.rationale: The audited contribution is the exact parity lift on the family with two arbitrary initial runs and last run of length one. The entire two-run base count and the alternating-triple specialization are prior or contemporaneous overlapping results; they are not credited as new here. The inspected sources do not determine the exceptional last-bit relation for arbitrary a,b. Inaccessible plausible general works are left unresolved rather than classified as noncovering.
residual_risks: Exact coverage by the inaccessible 2011 trie paper or the located modular-and-threshold counting paper is unresolved. Abstracts, access failures and search misses do not establish priority. An older general group-orbit calculation could change the originality comparison.

value.rationale: This supplies exact deterministic memory for a natural returning-letter extension of a two-run pattern. The full family classification identifies when a new output bit is genuinely independent and when a pointwise parity invariant removes it. Its Θ(a·2^b) states compared to a naive prefix bit for every pattern position, and its explicit necessary-and-sufficient boundary, describe a structural effect not captured by a list of examples. The result is limited to parity and a final run of length one.
